title: dubwirbeln Velocity Curve
description: Velocity shape over the roll. Positions are normalized over the 4-bar reference (0 = start, 1 = end); values are MIDI velocity units. Values between points are linearly interpolated.

type.description: Curve type. Variate never changes it.

points.description: Editable control points. Variate may move each point's velocity by +/-10.
